_metadata.description: The safety core: statically prove test-isolation via the four routed-DB seams, enforce variant-aware (shadow-safe) namespaces, fail-safe on non-Go surfaces, and map an unproven result to the L2 rung that test-genie consumes as a fail-closed precondition for destructive playbooks. Also ships the prove-isolation CLI.

requirements.title: Four-seam routed-isolation static proof
requirements.description: Statically prove a Go scenario routes test traffic to an isolated pool by checking all four seams are wired: database.Open returning *RoutedDB, database.EnsureSchemas, apihttp.TestModeMiddleware, and devrouting.Register. Any missing seam emits ROUTED_SEAMS_UNWIRED at L2 (safety_blocker). A scenario with no relational store passes L2 vacuously.

validation.notes: A routed-eligible scenario (all four seams wired) passes L2 with no ROUTED_SEAMS_UNWIRED finding.
A raw *sql.DB-capture fixture missing the seams produces ROUTED_SEAMS_UNWIRED at L2 with loud, instructive remediation naming the exact seam.
A scenario with no relational store passes L2 without emitting an isolation finding.

requirements.title: Variant-aware namespace adoption (shadow-safety)
requirements.description: Detect hard-coded Qdrant collection names / Redis prefixes that bypass the variant-aware storage helpers (storage.Collection / RedisKey / RedisPrefix / ScenarioNamespace) and emit STORAGE_NAMESPACE_HARDCODED at L2. Variant-aware namespaces keep shadow/live instances isolated.

validation.notes: A hard-coded Qdrant collection literal produces STORAGE_NAMESPACE_HARDCODED; a storage.Collection(domain) call does not.

requirements.title: Non-Go isolation fail-safe
requirements.description: When code-facts reports a non-Go API surface, isolation cannot be statically proven; emit STORAGE_ISOLATION_UNVERIFIED at L2 (advisory-visible, never a silent pass). This finding drives the same fail-closed gate as ROUTED_SEAMS_UNWIRED so destructive playbooks are refused.

validation.notes: A non-Go API fixture produces STORAGE_ISOLATION_UNVERIFIED and never a silent clean L2 pass.

requirements.title: Fail-closed destructive-playbook gate verdict
requirements.description: Expose an isolation verdict (the L2 result) that test-genie consumes as a precondition for destructive playbooks. When L2 is not proven, test-genie must refuse destructive playbooks with a loud skip stating why it skipped, the real-data risk, and the exact remediation; read-only playbooks remain allowed where declared.

validation.notes: Against a non-cooperating fixture, test-genie emits a loud fail-closed skip of destructive playbooks (why / real-data risk / remediation), not a silent restart fallback.
Against a routed-eligible scenario, destructive playbooks run and the routed leak-counter primary_during_test_mode_requests stays 0.

requirements.title: prove-isolation CLI verb
requirements.description: Provide `storage-health prove-isolation <scenario> [--json]` that runs the isolation analyzers standalone and exits nonzero with remediation when isolation cannot be statically proven, exit 0 when it can. This is the standalone operator entry point to the L2 verdict.

validation.notes: prove-isolation on a routed-eligible scenario exits 0; on a non-cooperating fixture exits nonzero with remediation text.
